panels.title: Total Revenue
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= COALESCE(:start_date, '0000-01-01') AND o.order_date <= COALESCE(:end_date, '9999-12-31')

panels.title: Completed Orders
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= COALESCE(:start_date, '0000-01-01') AND order_date <= COALESCE(:end_date, '9999-12-31')

panels.title: Avg Order Value
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(line_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS value FROM (SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_total FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= COALESCE(:start_date, '0000-01-01') AND o.order_date <= COALESCE(:end_date, '9999-12-31') GROUP BY oi.order_id)

panels.title: Customers w/ Orders
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= COALESCE(:start_date, '0000-01-01') AND order_date <= COALESCE(:end_date, '9999-12-31')

panels.title: Revenue by Month
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS label, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= COALESCE(:start_date, '0000-01-01') AND o.order_date <= COALESCE(:end_date, '9999-12-31') GROUP BY label ORDER BY label

panels.title: Revenue by Category
panels.sql: SELECT p.category AS label, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS value FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= COALESCE(:start_date, '0000-01-01') AND o.order_date <= COALESCE(:end_date, '9999-12-31') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Acquisition Channel
panels.sql: SELECT channel AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM customers GROUP BY channel ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Top Products by Revenue
panels.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, p.category AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= COALESCE(:start_date, '0000-01-01') AND o.order_date <= COALESCE(:end_date, '9999-12-31') GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Revenue by Country
panels.sql: SELECT c.country AS label, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= COALESCE(:start_date, '0000-01-01') AND o.order_date <= COALESCE(:end_date, '9999-12-31') GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY value DESC
